title: Vista Colina Family Shelter:
title_q: “A Landing Pad, Then a Launching Pad”
headline: Homelessness can happen to anyone; at Vista Colina, families find a landing pad that the CASS team turns into a launching pad.
story: A claim, then the man who proves it. Brittnie says homelessness can happen to anyone; Ian shows how it happened to his family. Crystal widens it from one family to every family.
The card says what makes Vista Colina different. Bri carries the children. Ian comes back with what he walks out with: six months and the next chapter.

Brittnie names the model, landing pad to launching pad, and hands it back to the viewer: your neighbors. Documentary, dignified, built from the campus and its people. It must hold up for years on YouTube.
